component.name: Bo Suite
component.summary: Spatial audio router for Mozart and Bluetooth speakers

description.p: Bo Suite routes audio across a mesh of speakers by room and channel, so a layout plays where you put it.

ul.li: Assign each channel of a layout to a speaker, one channel per speaker
Rooms are saved and restored, including partial restores onto a changed mesh
Per-band EQ with headroom warnings, and a seamless-loop finder for ambience
